notes.title: Patch notes for Version 1.0.4
notes.notes: [p][u]Tech[/u][/p][p]- Optimizations to enemy pathing[/p][p][/p][p][u]Design[/u][/p][p]- Player may now unlock items that are linked to Catanothoa, Cathulhu, Nyanlathotep, and Shub-Niggurat by defeating Face of Petrification, Tails of Chaos, Steps to Oblivion, and Unending Madness respectively.[/p][p]- Enemies now have better pathing to move around non-moving enemies[/p][p][/p][p][u]Polish[/u][/p][p]- Added helper prompts for objectives that are less intuitive, namely Stepping on Floor Buttons, Clearing Orbs, Revealing Wolf Sigils and fighting Sw\[AMP]ere[/p][p]- Added clickable arrows to spells display[/p][p]- Added additional indicators for items/spells which are passive[/p][p]- Added icons to item/spell descriptions[/p][p]- Added auto-scroll toggle to cutscenes[/p][p]- Tweaks to tutorial flow[/p][p]- Added new room design for treasure rooms[/p][p]- Tweak to allow players to cancel key rebinding[/p][p]- Tweak to display enemy attack indicators above players instead of below[/p][p][/p][p][u]Bugfix[/u][/p][p]- Bugfix for game hanging randomly[/p][p]- Bugfix for game glitches when rebinding controls, notably Open Map[/p][p]- Bugfix for game crash during boss battle against Unending Madness if player summons friendly monsters[/p][p]- Bugfix for visual glitch when players have mana absorb spells and try to break free from mud[/p][p]- Bugfix for players being able to move during certain cutscenes[/p][p]- Bugfix for enemies being able to move before certain items/spells resolve[/p][p]- Bugfix for keyboard controls not working properly in the campsite[/p][p][/p][p][u]Issues being investigated[/u][/p][p]- Bugs caused by players using Elementerraform under certain circumstances[/p][p]- Improvements to make the game more playable using only mouse[/p]

notes.title: Patch notes for Version 1.0.3
notes.notes:
[p][u]Tech[/u][/p][p]- Added support for Windows 32-bit[/p][p]- Added support for MacOS Apple Silicon[/p][p]- Internal engine tweaks for improved gameplay stability[/p][p][/p][p][u]Polish[/u][/p][p]- Tweak to make Heal and Warming Shawl spells unusable if player is at max HP[/p][p]- Tweak to close spell select screen when player opens other screens[/p][p]- Crediting Tom Purdue as The Friendly Necromancer[/p][p][/p][p][u]Bugfix[/u][/p][p]- Bugfix for game hanging if player has Draw Map perk and enters certain boss rooms in Chapter 4[/p][p]- Bugfix for game hanging if player changes colorblind mode during the tutorial[/p][p]- Bugfix for players being able to glitch the tutorial by performing incorrect actions[/p][p]- Bugfix for incorrect sprites getting loaded when players switch between colorblind modes[/p][p]- Bugfix for Exomaniac Staff spells not visually targeting the correct tiles[/p][p]- Bugfix for players being able to open Elementerraform and Stats screens during cutscenes[/p][p]- Bugfix for visual bug if player presses Toggle Spell Select button while targeting a spell[/p][p]- Bugfix for incorrect enemy icon in Bestiary

[u]Issues being investigated[/u][/p][p]- Game hanging randomly when players use spells[/p][p]- Game hanging if player defeats Red Dragon when it lands[/p][p]- Game glitching randomly when players use Elementerraform[/p][p]- Game hanging randomly when players enter new rooms[/p][p]- Steam cloud save not syncing properly if player switches between different accounts[/p][p][/p][p][u]Upcoming changes[/u][/p][p]- Improved mouse UI for switching between spell pages[/p][p]- Possible UI prompts during early stages to help remind players how to complete certain objectives[/p]

notes.title: Patch notes for Version 1.0.2
notes.notes: [p][u]Tech[/u][/p][p]- Smoother processing of pieces falling diagonally[/p][p]- Internal improvements to game stability[/p][p][/p][p][u]Polish[/u][/p][p]- Added map indicators showing where stairs to lower floors are located once uncovered[/p][p]- Added additional comic popups explaining Upkeep and Drain when players pick up the relevant items[/p][p]- Added indicators on the spell buttons indicating when items/spells have upkeep[/p][p]- Added better visual feedback for comic popups[/p][p]- Added tweaks to prevent players from using Glove/Vambrace Overdrivers, Unstable Mana Trigger and Warm Fuzzy Feelings when there are no viable targets[/p][p][/p][p]Bugfix[/p][p]- Bugfix for game crashing in Lava level[/p][p]- Bugfix for game hanging when performing fast travel[/p][p]- Bugfix for Chilling Beam not working[/p][p]- Bugfix for Cementicore Mane not working as intended[/p][p]- Bugfix for game hanging if player attempts to use Glove/Vambrace Overdrivers without enough viable targets[/p][p]- Bugfix for game errors when player is fighting Jellyfloat[/p][p]- Bugfix for visual glitch when player enters shop with no available Conveyance items[/p][p]- Bugfix for Masamewne/Mewramasa not processing Upkeep properly[/p][p]- Bugfix for visual glitch when players change video settings and colorblind mode simultaneously[/p][p]- Bugfix for time freeze display not appearing when player loads a continue save[/p][p]- Bugfix for time freeze display appearing off centered[/p][p]- Bugfix for game glitching when players attempt to rebind controller inputs to mouse and keyboard setup and vice versa[/p][p]- Bugfix for large enemies tackling diagonally to hit player[/p][p]- Bugfix for certain spells not displaying Drain requirements properly[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Emergency Bugfix for Black Screen Bug MacOS Patch Release
notes.notes:
We are able to confirm that Version 1.0.1 containing the emergency bugfix addressing the bug that caused the game to be stuck on a black screen after launching the game is now available on MacOS. Thank you for your patience.

- Roguematch Team

notes.title: Emergency Bugfix for Black Screen Bug on Launch
notes.notes: [p]Salutations players,[/p][p][/p][p]As mentioned in a previous post, we have received bug reports that the players encounter a black screen upon loading the game. We have verified that the bug affects all players who freshly install the game after version 1.0.0 and we have since pushed out a bugfix for the issue in Version 1.0.1.[/p][p][/p][p]It is inexcusable that such a major bug was not caught in our internal QA processes and we sincerely apologise for all inconvenience caused. We will keep a look out for any other bug reports and we will strive to resolve them as quickly as we can.[/p][p][/p][p]For MacOS players, we seek your understanding that it will take few more hours for us to push out Version 1.0.1 on to MacOS platforms so we seek your understanding while we resolve the matter.[/p][p][/p][p]Once again, we at the Roguematch team sincerely apologise for any and all inconvenience caused.[/p][p][/p][p]- Roguematch Team[/p]

notes.title: Regarding Black Screen Bug on Game Load
notes.notes: [p]Salutations players,[/p][p][/p][p]We have received bug reports that players are experiencing a black screen error once they launch the game. Our team is currently looking into the issue and we should have a patch fix for the issue within a few hours. It is inexcusable that such a major bug was not detected within our internal QA prior to launch and we extend our sincerest apologies for the inconvenience caused.[/p][p][/p][p]We will post another update once we are able to push out the bug fix.[/p][p][/p][p]- Roguematch Team[/p]

notes.title: Roguematch : The Extraplanar Invasion is now fully released!
notes.notes: [p]Salutations players![/p][p][/p][p]It is with great pleasure and honour to finally announce that Roguematch : The Extraplanar Invasion is leaving Early Access and is now fully released! We humbly apologise that our stint in Early Access took much, much longer than we anticipated but the team wanted to ensure that Roguematch was in a state worthy of a full release before leaving Early Access.[/p][p][/p][p]We want to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all players who contributed to our Early Access. Without your invaluable feedback and playtesting, Roguematch will most certainly not even be half the game that it is now.[/p][p][/p][p]Moving forward, we will continue to look out for more player feedback and bug reports and we will continue to support Roguematch for the foreseeable future.[/p][p][/p][p]With that, we hope you enjoy your adventures in Roguematch : The Extraplanar Invasion![/p][p][/p][p]- Roguematch Team[/p]

notes.title: Roguematch is now Steam Deck Verified!
notes.notes: [p]Salutations players! [/p][p][/p][p]One of the goals our team has had for Roguematch : The Extraplanar Invasion is to be able to reach as wide an audience as possible. So in line with that vision, we are extremely excited to announce that Roguematch is now Steam Deck Verified! Getting Steam Deck Verified is a big milestone for our team's endeavour to ensure a quality play experience for all players, regardless of platform. notes.title: Patch notes for Version 0.2.0
notes.notes:
[i]Developers' notes: We apologise for the lack of updates and communication these past few months. We've been hard at work with the process of porting Roguematch to consoles to line up with the full release of the game on the consoles as well as Steam. However, that required us to undertake an overhaul of the game's internal game engine so we were not able to push out updates as frequently as we would have liked to because we still needed to ensure the full game would be in a playable state after the overhaul was completed. We have quite a number of features that have been compiled from the past few months of work put into this patch and we hope to be able to move back to more frequent game and communication updates regarding the game soon.[/i]

[u]Tech[/u]
- Internal game engine overhaul to improve memory performance overall

[u]Design[/u]
- Shaded enemy now is now only invulnerable for 2 turns instead of 3
- Anti-Shadow Reaction spell now does damage equal to the amount of Calm Mana the player possesses as opposed to the amount of the player's Calm Mana match damage
